reason: The old methods are kept as thin obsolete wrappers delegating to the new global-namespace extension class, so existing call sites keep compiling and behaving the same, with only a minor risk from the moved ProjectReference (Abstractions -> full ContentManagement) potentially introducing new transitive dependencies/circularities.
